import MilneLib.Quotient.InvariantQuotientStableOverlap
import MilneLib.Sheaf.SemilinearAlgebras

/-!
# Galois actions on stable section rings

An action on a scheme over `Spec L` compatible with the Galois action on the
base induces a semilinear action on the sections of every stable open. The
section algebras over `K` and `L` are both those induced by the actual structure
morphisms, so the resulting scalar tower agrees with the invariant-quotient
charts. This is the passage from geometric actions to the affine algebraic
descent input in Milne III.1.13.

The semilinearity calculation adapts
`AlgebraicJacobian/Descent/GaloisQuotientGlue.lean` in the sibling rebuild project.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

section StructureMaps

variable {K L : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing L] {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- Composition of a structure morphism with a map of affine bases induces
the composite map on scalar coefficients. -/
lemma sectionsAlgebraMapHom_comp (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
    (f : K →+* L) (U : X.Opens) :
    sectionsAlgebraMapHom (p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) U =
      CommRingCat.ofHom f ≫ sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U := by
  rw [sectionsAlgebraMapHom, sectionsAlgebraMapHom, Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).symm

variable (K L) in
/-- The canonical section algebras over two successive affine bases form a
scalar tower. -/
lemma sections_isScalarTower [Algebra K L]
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) (U : X.Opens) :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
    letI := sectionsAlgebra (p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) U
    IsScalarTower K L Γ(X, U) := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  letI := sectionsAlgebra (p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) U
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro k
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (sectionsAlgebraMapHom_comp p (algebraMap K L) U)) k

/-- The affine-coordinate isomorphism respects the structure morphism that
defines the algebra on sections. -/
@[reassoc]
lemma isoSpec_hom_comp_structureMap (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
    hU.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Γ(X, U))) =
      U.ι ≫ p := by
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  suffices h : hU.isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (p.appLE ⊤ U le_top) ≫
        Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv = U.ι ≫ p by
    simpa [sectionsAlgebraMapHom, Scheme.Hom.appLE,
      RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using h
  rw [hU.isoSpec_hom]
  have hn := Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE p ⊤ U le_top
  calc
    U.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (p.appLE ⊤ U le_top) ≫
          Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv =
        (p.resLE ⊤ U le_top ≫
          (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens).toSpecΓ) ≫
          Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv :=
      congrArg (fun z => z ≫ Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv) hn
    _ = U.ι ≫ p := by
      rw [Category.assoc]
      simp

end StructureMaps

section Semilinearity

variable (K L : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  (act : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) →* Aut X) (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))
  (hact : ∀ g : L ≃ₐ[K] L,
    (act g).hom ≫ p = p ≫ (specAction (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g).hom)
  {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U)

include hact

/-- The geometric compatibility square twists section coefficients by the
inverse field automorphism, as required by contravariance. -/
lemma actApp_sectionsAlgebraMapHom (g : L ≃ₐ[K] L) :
    sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U ≫ actApp act hU g =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g⁻¹) ≫
        sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U := by
  rw [sectionsAlgebraMapHom, actApp, Category.assoc,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, appLE_congr_hom (hact g),
    appLE_congr_hom (congrArg (p ≫ ·) (specAction_hom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g)),
    Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (MulSemiringAction.toRingHom (L ≃ₐ[K] L) L g⁻¹))).symm

/-- The action on a stable section ring is semilinear over the Galois action
on the coefficient field. -/
theorem isSemilinear_sections :
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
    letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
    GaloisDescent.IsSemilinear K L Γ(X, U) := by
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
  letI := sectionsAlgebra p U
  refine GaloisDescent.SemilinearAction.isSemilinear_of_smul_algebraMap
    K L Γ(X, U) fun g a => ?_
  change (actApp act hU g⁻¹).hom ((sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U).hom a) =
    (sectionsAlgebraMapHom p U).hom (g a)
  have h := congrArg (fun m => CommRingCat.Hom.hom m a)
    (actApp_sectionsAlgebraMapHom K L act p hact hU g⁻¹)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1

end Semilinearity

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
